quarterly_data.signal: CrowdStrike launched the first geographic localization of Project QuiltWorks, a dedicated North American partner cohort delivering frontier AI readiness expertise and remediation services in the U.S. and Canada: Blackthorne Consulting, CDW, Consortium, Echelon Risk + Cyber, EVOTEK, GuidePoint Security, NETbuilder, Optiv, Pondurance and Presidio help customers turn QuiltWorks findings into prioritized remediation. QuiltWorks is powered by frontier models from OpenAI and Anthropic and open Nemotron models from NVIDIA, with AWS cloud infrastructure and cyber-insurance partners; the program is being regionalized.
